senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. מוּךְ) [to lie under,] to support; [to make to lie under,] to rest upon, lay upon, press.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 16:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVI, 5</cite> (ref. to <he>תומיך</he>, <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 16:4">ib.</cite>) <he>הגורל הזה תְּמָכַנִי בסיני</he> this lot (martyrdom) was laid on me at Sinai; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 667">Yalk. ib. 667</cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:3">Num. R. s. 13<sup>3</sup></cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 29:23">Prov. XXIX, 23</cite>) <he>ת׳ הקב״ה כבודו עליו וכ׳</he> the Lord rested his glory upon it (Sinai), and on it he gave the Law.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite> <he>ת׳ ידו … להעבירה וכ׳</he> he (Joseph) held up Jacob’s hand to remove it &c.; a. e.
